lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a repeating rectilinear grid posterior to the pectoral fin, with vertical spacing between centroids remaining relatively uniform across the visible mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance circular clusters, creating a visible grid-like network of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring light pixels on the superior edge and a defined shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a localized high-density distribution of small-diameter, high-luminance pixel clusters that are significantly smaller than the primary blobs observed on the lateral flank.
